name: Nan Luo

name: Nancy Devlin

name: Nick Bansback
reason: Exact name and a coherent Canadian health-economics, PROMs, shared decision-making, and utility-valuation record. It includes the Canadian EQ-5D-5L value set, discrete-choice utility work, and collaboration with EuroQol researchers including Nancy Devlin and John Brazier.

name: Nils Gutacker
